title: Origin story: Durnok
description: Durnok was a quarry-carver who sang to the stone as he worked, and the mountain sang back. Over sixty years the songs braided him into the rock itself, until one morning the quarrymen found the cliff face standing upright, blinking granite eyes. He walks now, slow as geology, carrying villages on his shoulders when floods come.
